title: Congress.gov Notifications Congress.gov Enhancements for August of 2026
summary:
We are pleased to bring you the Congress.gov enhancements for August of 2026

Enhancement – Legislation – Related Bills

  • Find two new types of bill relationships on the Related Bills tab in a new accordion format.
  • Contained in public law indicates the text of a measure is contained in the public law text of a bill that became law. For example, the text of H.R. 8878 is contained in the text of H.R.6644, which became Public Law 119-101.
  • A note highlighting the relationship appears in search results and in the bill overview.
  • Reintroduction links two bills in consecutive Congresses having the same official title, same sponsor, and introduced text versions that are identical or nearly identical. For example, H.R. 9268 from the 117th Congress was reintroduced as H.R.1318 in the 118th Congress.
